description: Expected results for icepack's own official test test/ice_shelf_test.py (icepack master c9a29780). Floating ice shelf, 20 km x 20 km, thickness 500 m -> 400 m, inflow 100 m/yr, T = 254.15 K; the diagnostic (momentum) solve is compared with the exact solution of Greve & Blatter on refined meshes. Pass rules: (a) the 4 official pytest tests pass with their own assert limits; (b) each printed convergence slope is above its official limit (official_min) AND equal to the value recorded on this server within tol. The test file prints slopes with 6 significant digits.
engine_version: icepack 1.1.0 (upstream master c9a29780) on firedrake 2026.10.0, PETSc 3.26.0, Python 3.12.3

numeric_checks.why: official pytest run finished with no failure

numeric_checks.why: 4 official tests: convergence[icepack], convergence[petsc], parameterization, side_friction

numeric_checks.name: side_friction_passed
numeric_checks.why: official sanity test: side-wall friction slows the shelf (norm(u) < norm(u_initial))

reference: official limits: the assert lines in inputs/ice_shelf_test.py (github.com/icepack/icepack, test/ice_shelf_test.py at c9a29780). Slope values: recorded from real runs on this server (no official reference file ships with the test).
notes: Official limits are the assert lines of the test file. Recorded slopes repeated exactly (6 printed digits) in 3 clean runs on 2026-10-06 (direct pytest, and run_reference.py twice). The KI run tool cannot drive this test (README, Known KI gaps); pytest runs under the KI's model interpreter (same lookup as preflight_check.py).
